notes: NEW MAP: DISPENSARY ROW (BETA). A neon high street at night: a dispensary with a vault in the middle and a roof over everything, laundromats and a back alley on one side, a bus parked across the street on the other.
NEW MAP: SMOKE OUT. A 4/20 music festival: the main stage in the middle, vendor tents and a giant inflatable joint on one side, bleachers and food trucks on the other.
NEW MODE: RE-UP. Every kill drops a stash bag. Grab them and carry them to one of the two STASH HOUSES to score. If you die carrying, you drop the whole pile. Offline, online and in private matches.
NEW MODE: PUFF PUFF PASS. Free-for-all where everyone has the same gun, and every 40 seconds it passes to a new one from the whole armory. Offline, online and in private matches.
FIX: the weapon list at the bottom right now updates when your gun is swapped (gun game too).
